notes: Unique random prefix per request prevents cross-run prefix-cache reuse. Context sizes are target words; actual prompt_tokens come from server usage. GPU memory is whole-device usage, includes other processes. Warmup excluded.

mac_memory.notes: 1-second samples, Ollama model-reported size_vram and summed process RSS are NOT whole-device GPU memory. Swap is whole-system and includes other existing applications. Other Docker projects were running. RSS includes only processes whose command name contains ollama, and is not a Metal allocation measurement. Runner-logged peak is the allocator metric, also not total system RAM.

environment.background: Existing unrelated Docker services and desktop apps left running; no vLLM installation, model downloads or new containers during the measured matrix.
